summary.background: In this study, we combined long-term eddy covariance data from the flux tower in Sorø, Denmark (DKSor) with an explainable machine learning framework to disentangle the direct effects of air temperature (T air ) on nighttime ER.
summary.method: Using an optimized machine learning model and Causal Shapley value, we quantified the marginal contributions of environmental predictors while accounting for known causal dependencies.
